F01.text: To minimize the risk of accidental ignition.

F02.text: To limit the severity and effects of fire or explosions.

F03.text: To retard the effects of fire on areas beyond its point of origin.

F04.text: To retard failure or collapse due to the effects of fire.

F05.text: To retard the effects of fire on emergency egress facilities.

F06.text: To retard the effects of fire on facilities for notification, suppression and emergency response.

F10.text: To facilitate the timely movement of persons to a safe place in an emergency.

F11.text: To notify persons, in a timely manner, of the need to take action in an emergency.

F13.text: To notify emergency responders, in a timely manner, of the need to take action in an emergency.

F20.text: To support and withstand expected loads and forces.

F21.text: To limit or accommodate dimensional change.

F22.text: To limit movement under expected loads and forces.

F23.text: To maintain equipment in place during structural movement.

F30.text: To minimize the risk of injury to persons as a result of tripping, slipping, falling, contact, drowning or collision.

F31.text: To minimize the risk of injury to persons as a result of contact with hot surfaces or substances.

F32.text: To minimize the risk of injury to persons as a result of contact with energized equipment.

F33.text: To limit the level of sound of a fire alarm system.

F34.text: To resist or discourage unwanted access or entry.

F35.text: To facilitate the identification of potential intruders.

F36.text: To minimize the risk that persons will be trapped in confined spaces.

F40.text: To limit the level of contaminants.

F41.text: To minimize the risk of generation of contaminants.

F42.text: To resist the entry of vermin and insects.

F43.text: To minimize the risk of release of hazardous substances.

F44.text: To limit the spread of hazardous substances beyond their point of release.

F46.text: To minimize the risk of contamination of potable water.

F50.text: To provide air suitable for breathing.

F51.text: To maintain appropriate air and surface temperatures.

F53.text: To maintain appropriate indoor/outdoor air pressure differences.

F55.text: To resist the transfer of air through environmental separators.

F56.text: To limit the transmission of airborne sound into a dwelling unit from spaces elsewhere in the building (see Sentence 3.1.1.2.(2) for application limitation).

F60.text: To control the accumulation and pressure of water on and in the ground.

F61.text: To resist the ingress of precipitation, water or moisture from the exterior or from the ground.

F62.text: To facilitate the dissipation of water and moisture from the building.

F71.text: To provide facilities for personal hygiene.

F72.text: To provide facilities for the sanitary disposal of human and domestic wastes.

F73.text: To facilitate access to and circulation in the building and its facilities by persons with physical or sensory limitations (see Sentence 3.1.1.2.(3) for application limitation).

F74.text: To facilitate the use of the building's facilities by persons with physical or sensory limitations (see Sentence 3.1.1.2.(3) for application limitation).

F80.text: To resist deterioration resulting from expected service conditions.

F81.text: To minimize the risk of malfunction, interference, damage, tampering, lack of use or misuse.

F82.text: To minimize the risk of inadequate performance due to improper maintenance or lack of maintenance.

F90.text: To limit the amount of uncontrolled air leakage through the building envelope.

F91.text: To limit the amount of uncontrolled air leakage through system components.

F92.text: To limit the amount of uncontrolled thermal transfer through the building envelope.

F93.text: To limit the amount of uncontrolled thermal transfer through system components.

F95.text: To limit the unnecessary demand and/or consumption of energy for heating and cooling.

F96.text: To limit the unnecessary demand and/or consumption of energy for service water heating.

F98.text: To limit the inefficiency of equipment.

F99.text: To limit the inefficiency of systems.

F100.text: To limit the unnecessary rejection of reusable waste energy.

F101.text: To minimize the risk of contamination of food.

F102.text: To minimize the risk of inhalation of pathogenic micro-organisms.

F103.text: To minimize the risk of ingestion of pathogenic micro-organisms.

F104.text: To minimize the risk of physical contact with pathogenic micro-organisms.

F105.text: To minimize the growth of pathogenic micro-organisms.

F106.text: To minimize the risk of space-to-space transfer of pathogenic micro-organisms.

F107.text: To minimize the risk of injury to persons as a result of contact with toxic or injurious substances.

F110.text: To limit the transmission of airborne sound, originating outside a building, through an assembly separating internal space from space outside the building.
